scenario: Adopt Lintwise as a required pre-merge check (eight engineers)

motion.text: The team trials Lintwise as a non-blocking check on its monorepo, measuring useful findings, false positives, CI runtime, and queue impact. Individual checks become required pre-merge only after team agreement on local evidence, acceptable CI cost, and dispute, outage, and rollback procedures.
